patthana14.32:1.1: kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. nakāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.32:4.1: rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. narūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na narūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.32:7.1: arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
